articles.title: Obol joins forces with Mastercard to Bring AI-Driven Cash Flow Management to Australian Businesses
articles.mainIdea: Obol joins forces with Mastercard to Bring AI-Driven Cash Flow Management to Australian Businesses
articles.summary: PR Newswire: Obol joins forces with Mastercard to Bring AI-Driven Cash Flow Management to Australian Businesses. Obol, an AI-driven cash flow management platform for modern businesses, announced its official launch in Australia through a strategic collaboration with Mastercard. This enables Obol to power its platform using Mastercard's open banking capabilities, supporting secure connectivity to financial data and expanding access to real-time cash flow management for Australian businesses.

These refreshed views lean on solid spending trends and Mastercard's role in cross border and digital payment flows, which analysts see as important for the revenue mix over time.
